title: Weather Window Finder for Action Sports
dataSources: E-bike rides (`ebike:ride`), scooter trips (`scooter:trip`), skate sessions (`skate:session`), surf sessions (`surf:session`), snow runs (`snow:run`).
app: Micro-mobility and action-sport trackers — e-bike / e-scooter apps (VanMoof, Bosch eBike Flow), and skate / surf / snow session trackers (Trace, Slopes, Xensr) with IMU sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal (sourcetype=surf:session OR sourcetype=ecowitt:obs)
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(eval(if(sourcetype=="ecowitt:obs",wind_kmh,null()))) as wind, avg(swell_m) as swell by _time
| eval good=if(wind<20 AND swell>1,1,0)
| where good=1
| sort - _time
description: Highlights the upcoming days whose forecast conditions suit your sport, so you never miss a perfect window.
value: Matching your logged good sessions to forecast conditions turns spare hours into well-timed sessions.
implementation: Join session conditions with forecasts in `index=personal`; surface upcoming favourable days.
visualization: Table of favourable upcoming days for your sport.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights the days coming up with the right weather for your sport, so you catch the good conditions.
